```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bash environment
        run: |
          # Ensure bash is available and set up any necessary environment variables
          echo "BASH_VERSION=${BASH_VERSION}"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          # Assuming the test suite is run via a script or command in the repository
          # Common patterns for shell projects:
          # 1. bash tests.sh
          # 2. make test
          # 3. ./run_tests.sh
          # 4. bats tests/
          
          # Check for common test runners
          if [ -f "tests.sh" ]; then
            bash tests.sh
          elif [ -f "Makefile" ] && grep -q "test:" Makefile; then
            make test
          elif [ -f "run_tests.sh" ]; then
            bash run_tests.sh
          elif command -v bats &> /dev/null && [ -d "tests" ]; then
            bats tests/
          else
            echo "No standard test runner found. Please ensure tests are executable."
            # Fallback: try to run any executable in tests directory if it exists
            if [ -d "tests" ]; then
              find tests -type f -executable -exec {} \;
            fi
          fi

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: |
            test-results/
            *.xml
            *.junit
          retention-days: 5
```
